annotations.title: Find Christmas markets near a place

description: Use this when someone asks where and when Christmas markets (Christkindlmarkts, holiday and craft markets) are near a US city, state or ZIP code, optionally on certain dates in the 2026 season. Returns up to 5 markets, nearest first, each with the organizer's published dates and hours (or a note that the dates are not announced yet), venue, setting, entry type, the official or visitor-bureau page we checked, the date we checked it, the date the answer stops being served and a link to our page. Dates change: always send people to the organizer's site to confirm. Do not use this to list every market, for markets outside the United States, for tickets or lodging, or for light displays and tree farms (find_christmas_lights_and_tree_farms covers those).

end_date.description: Optional last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Date ranges are limited to 120 days.

place.description: The place to search around: "City, ST" (for example "Edmond, OK"), a US state, or a 5-digit ZIP code. 2-60 characters. Wildcards and "all" are not accepted.

radius_miles.description: Optional search radius in miles, 5 to 250. Default 60. Ignored when the place is a whole state.

start_date.description: Optional first day you want to go, YYYY-MM-DD (2026 season). Leave out to search from today.

name: find_christmas_markets

link.description: Page on our site with details.

observed.description: Date the fact was observed or verified (YYYY-MM-DD).
